objects.name: CrowdStrike to Acquire Fiddler to Deliver Falcon Observe for AI Agent Observability
objects.description: Mobile carriers can retain years of call and text metadata, exposing sensitive details about customers' relationships, locations, and daily routines if breached. Cape examines the privacy risks of long-term telecom data retention and how its mobile service reduces exposure by automatically deleting call records.
